title: 98% of classical knowledge lost

tellings.quote: you know that um I'm getting this figure from Carl Sean We lost 98% of the knowledge of classical antiquity.

plain: Ninety-eight percent of the knowledge of the ancient Greek and Roman world has been lost, through events such as the destruction of the Library of Alexandria and of Corinth. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this and says he takes the figure from the astronomer Carl Sagan. He uses it to suggest how much of the ancient past we no longer know.
